description: This file contains utility functions for managing workspace directories related to job storage in a software project. It provides functions to retrieve the root workspace and specific job-related subdirectories, creating them if they do not exist.

methods.name: Path get_root_workspace()
methods.description: Returns the root directory path for job storage, based on an environment variable or defaulting to a 'workspace' folder under the project.

methods.name: Dict[str,Path] get_job_workspace(job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of paths for various subdirectories related to a specific job, creating them if they do not exist.
